defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

defensiveAbilities.name: Plaque Burst
defensiveAbilities.description: When killed, a tooth fairy swarm bursts into sticky, foul-smelling white dust. Each creature in a 15ft Emanation must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Pinch
offensiveAbilities.description: Tooth fairies pinch their victims' fingers, noses, ears, or similar protruding body parts. Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail this save are Sickened 1 from the pain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pry
offensiveAbilities.description:
The tooth fairies try to pry out one of their target's teeth. One enemy in the swarm's space takes 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failed save, the target takes 2 Bleed Damage damage and loses a tooth.

If the creature loses a tooth, it takes a –1 status penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and must succeed at a Basic DC 5 Flat to Cast a Spell unless that spell has the subtle trait. These effects last for 1 day, or until the stolen tooth is returned and the target regains at least 1 Hit Point.

Effect: Tooth Tug
